tasks.title: Grounding pass: lock down V2 list-page conventions before authoring
tasks.description:
Read-only conventions pass. No source files are modified in this task; the deliverable is a short set of notes appended to .jonggrang/progress.txt that the authoring task consumes.

Read in full:
- api-reference-v2/bundling/index.mdx (canonical cursor-paginated V2 list page)
- api-reference-v2/discount/detail.mdx, create.mdx, validate.mdx, check.mdx (sibling discount pages)
- One more V2 list page for cross-check: api-reference-v2/invoice/index.mdx or api-reference-v2/reqpayment/index.mdx

Extract and record verbatim:
1. Frontmatter keys and their exact order/quoting (title, openapi, description) and the pseudo openapi path pattern (e.g. "GET /endpointbundlingv2/index", "GET /endpointdiscountv2/detail") so the new page can use a consistent pseudo path such as "GET /endpointdiscountv2/index".
2. The maintainer-note JSX comment convention ({/* Notes for maintainers: ... */}) — placement (immediately after frontmatter), tone, and the statement that identifiers are synthetic.
3. Ordering and exact tag usage of <RequestExample>, <ResponseExample>, <CodeGroup>, <ParamField>, <ResponseField> — including blank-line spacing around tags, code-fence language + title convention (```bash Request Example, ```json Response Example 200), and how nested object fields are expressed (nested <ResponseField> inside <Expandable> vs dotted paths).
4. The exact heading text and phrasing used for the Production/Sandbox <CodeGroup> endpoint block, the Authorization section, the Query Parameters section, and the Response section.
5. The sandbox host convention (api.mayar.club) and the /hl/v2 path prefix.

Acceptance criteria: .jonggrang/progress.txt contains a dated entry titled with this feature id listing the above five items concretely (actual strings, not paraphrase). No .mdx or docs.json file is changed by this task.

tasks.title: Author api-reference-v2/discount/index.mdx (GET /hl/v2/coupons list page)
tasks.description:
Create the new file api-reference-v2/discount/index.mdx documenting the cursor-paginated coupon / discount-campaign list endpoint, mirroring api-reference-v2/bundling/index.mdx structure exactly as captured in task-001.

Required content, in order:
1. Frontmatter: title "Get List Coupon", openapi "GET /endpointdiscountv2/index", description describing a paginated list of coupons / discount campaigns.
2. Maintainer-note JSX comment stating that the response shape is transcribed from the supplied source specification (list projection, which differs from the single-record projection on detail.mdx), that all identifiers/names/values in examples are synthetic, and that the mobile surface is intentionally not documented.
3. <RequestExample> with a curl GET to https://api.mayar.id/hl/v2/coupons?limit=10 using --header 'Authorization: Bearer Paste-Your-API-Key-Here'.
4. <ResponseExample> with a ```json Response Example 200 block containing the success envelope: statusCode, messages, data, hasMore, nextStartingAfter. data holds a flat coupons[] array; each item includes id, name, status, discountValue, totalUsage, createdAt and expiredAt as ISO-8601 strings (NOT ms integers), and a nested products[] array. Also include ```json Response Example 400 and ```json Response Example 500 error blocks matching the error envelope shape used by sibling V2 discount pages.
5. A <CodeGroup> endpoint block giving Production https://api.mayar.id/hl/v2/coupons and Sandbox https://api.mayar.club/hl/v2/coupons, using the exact phrasing/heading convention from the sibling pages.
6. Authorization section: Bearer token header, documented with <ParamField header="Authorization"> per sibling-page convention.
7. Query Parameters section documenting exactly five OPTIONAL parameters via <ParamField query=...>: limit (page size), startingAfter (cursor — pass the nextStartingAfter value from the previous response), status (enum: active, inactive, expired, upcoming — list the accepted values without inventing transition semantics), search (free-text match on coupon/campaign name), productId (filter campaigns applying to a given product).
8. Response section documenting via <ResponseField>: statusCode, messages, data, hasMore (boolean loop terminator), nextStartingAfter (cursor for the next page), then the nested coupons[] item fields (id, name, status, discountValue, totalUsage, createdAt, expiredAt, products) and the nested products[] item fields, using the nesting style captured in task-001.
9. A short explicit note on cursor pagination: feed nextStartingAfter back as startingAfter and keep looping while hasMore is true.

Constraints: document the headless surface only — never mention /mobile/v2/coupons. Do not modify detail.mdx, create.mdx, validate.mdx, or check.mdx. All example ids must be synthetic UUID-shaped values and all names/amounts fictional; no real merchant data or real API keys.

Acceptance criteria: file exists at api-reference-v2/discount/index.mdx, all JSON code blocks parse as valid JSON, every MDX component used is one already in use elsewhere in the repo, and the page structure matches bundling/index.mdx section-for-section.

tasks.title: Validation and consistency sweep for the new coupon list page
tasks.description:
Final verification pass over the change set. Read-only except for appending findings to .jonggrang/progress.txt.

Checks to perform and report:
1. JSON validity: docs.json parses (node -e JSON.parse round-trip).
2. Slug resolution: every page slug added or present in the V2 Discount & Coupon group maps to a real file on disk (api-reference-v2/discount/<slug>.mdx). Confirm api-reference-v2/discount/index.mdx exists.
3. Embedded JSON: each ```json block in api-reference-v2/discount/index.mdx parses as valid JSON.
4. Frontmatter sanity: title, openapi, and description keys present and quoted consistently with sibling V2 pages.
5. Data hygiene: no real merchant names, no real customer emails, no live API keys or Bearer tokens (the placeholder must be Paste-Your-API-Key-Here), all ids synthetic UUID-shaped values.
6. Scope containment: `git status --short` and `git diff --stat` show only api-reference-v2/discount/index.mdx (new) and docs.json (modified) — plus .jonggrang bookkeeping files. Confirm detail.mdx, create.mdx, validate.mdx, check.mdx, the V1 discount pages, and api-reference/openapi.json are all untouched.
7. Surface check: grep the new page for "mobile" to confirm the /mobile/v2 surface was not documented.

Acceptance criteria: all seven checks pass, or any failure is fixed within the two in-scope files and re-verified. Append the check results to .jonggrang/progress.txt.
